QuestInfo.name: Rain's Maple Quiz 1
QuestInfo.0: I'm not a beginner anymore. Talk to #b#p19##k in #b#m1010##k and take the Maple Quiz!
QuestInfo.1: I'm not a total newbie anymore. Talk to #b#p19##k and take the Maple Quiz!
QuestInfo.2: #b#p19#'s#k first question was about how to hang from a ladder or rope. All right! #bUp arrow key#k, make sure to remember it well.

0.0: Hello! How're you liking Maple World so far? Let me give you a brief rundown of the place, and then I'll give you a quiz. If you answer my questions correctly, I'll give you something handy. Interested?

yes.0: Hehe! Let me warn you, don't underestimate my quiz. There's a lot to learn, so pay attention!
yes.1: How is your adventure on Maple Island so far? You can go left with the #bleft arrow key#k and right with the #bright arrow key#k, right? Do you also know that if you press the #bdown arrow key#k, you can crouch, and then jump while crouching, to leap down to a lower platform? If you press the #bup arrow key#k in front of a portal, you can enter it, and if you press the #bup arrow key#k in front of a ladder or rope, you can climb or hang from it.
yes.2: You can also use the #rKey Config#k on the bottom right of your screen to recalibrate the buttons to your liking. Hmm. I think this explanation might have gotten a little too complicated. Don't worry, you'll get the hang of it as you spend more time here and get used to things.
yes.3:
But what you haven't experienced yet is Job Advancement. To become a more powerful traveler, you need a job! To get one, you'll first have to leave this place, Maple Island, and head to Victoria Island. 
You need to be at least at level #b10#k to become a #bWarrior, Bowman, Magician#k or #bThief#k. Each job has its pros and cons, so choose carefully.
yes.4: I didn't tell you EVERYTHING you need to know for the quiz, so make sure to focus. Ready for the questions?

no.0: Hmm, you could learn a lot through my quiz. I think you should try it!

1.0:
What key should you press in front of a ladder or rope to hang from it? 

#L0# #bleft arrow key
#L1# right arrow key
#L2# up arrow key
#L3# down arrow key#k#l
1.1: That's right! If you press the #rup arrow key#k in front of a ladder or rope, you can hang from it!

0.0: The left arrow key is for moving left. Do you remember which key you need to press in front of a ladder or rope?
0.1: No, no. The right arrow is the key for moving right. Think carefully!
0.3: Huh? The down arrow key is used to crouch or move to a lower platform. So, it can't be the down arrow key, right?
